translation: Now, the outer terrace (Waitai) is the office of the prefect; the arcane essentials (Miyao) mean the secret and the pivotal. Wang Tao of the Tang served in the high court for more than twenty years, long knowing the Hongwen Academy, and obtained the formulas of past and present, from Shennong above down to the Tang age, gathering and collecting without exception, and assembled them into forty volumes of canonical formulas, all being the secret and pivotal of the various formulas. Because he went out to guard in the provinces, he named it the 《Waitai Miyao Fang》, with 1,104 sections in all, heading each with Chao's 《Bingyuan》 and the discourses of the various schools; the learning of one school is not without detail.
